rows.en: Jiro or Ichiro is defeated
It was a peaceful night… The temperature was pleasant, the humidity was pleasant, and even night-owl Tokyo was sleeping soundly. But here was one unfortunate man…

12,516 sheep, 12,517 sheep… 12,518 sheep…

Gaaah… Arashi's snoring really is a total "storm". It's so loud I can't get any sleep…
Hey, Ide! Get up!
12,523 sheep, 12,524 sheep…
What are you mumbling about? We're assembling! Hurry, let's go!
What happened, Cap?

We got word from the TDF!

An object emitting powerful radio waves flew in over Tokyo, and while they were on alert, the signal suddenly vanished…
Huh, uh… So you mean a flying saucer or something flew in?
Or maybe it was a meteorite?
No, more importantly, Cap… where's the site?
I had Hayata, who's out on patrol, head straight to the TDF. We should be hearing from him any time now…

Cap, this is Hayata.

The signal stopped at 35 degrees 43 minutes north latitude, 139 degrees 38 minutes east longitude. The electronic computer is working out the details.
Whoa!? Isn't that smack in the middle of Tokyo?
This location is the TDF Science Center, isn't it? Arashi!
Yes, sir. I've been waiting for this! Heading there right away!
So this is the TDF Science Center? All right…

Ah, the Black Cross Army!?

I see… So the flying object was you lot?

Flying object!? What are you talking about?

Our target is Dr. Namikawa of the Science Center!

I'm Baseball Mask, batting a thousand… If you don't want to get hurt, you'd better give me an intentional walk!
What!? A real man throws nothing but fastballs!
Hold on with that showdown!
Pitching change, Baseball Mask!
Arashi… leave this to us!
You're from EAGLE? Right, I'll leave the Black Cross Army to you!
Whoa!? Waaaagh!
Fwoh-fwoh-fwoh-fwoh-fwoh…

…Time, time out!

Nngh… In baseball, anything can happen with two outs in the bottom of the ninth… You'll pay for this, Gorenger! This game isn't over yet!
Right, let's go after Arashi!
Right, let's go after Arashi!
Arashi… where could he be?

…!?

The Center staff!?
…What's happened here, eh? Everybody's frozen stiff in funny poses.
Watch yourself, Daita… Looks like something's lurking in here!
Whoa!?

Whoa there…

You're from EAGLE?

It's dangerous here… I ran into what looked like an alien. It was a tough opponent! We'd better fall back for now.
All right, understood…
So you're saying we don't even know where this alien-like thing's spaceship is?
Not only is the staff's condition unknown, sir, but Dr. Namikawa's whereabouts are unknown as well.
Muramatsu… does the Science Patrol have some plan, then?
At the moment, no. But…
"But"? Have you got something in mind?
Well, it's just…
Out with it! What is it?
I'm thinking… we might try talking with them.
Hmph, what are you saying?
This is no time for that kind of talk, Muramatsu…
Let's be serious here, Muramatsu.
I am serious about it.

This is pointless.

I hear they used weapons we've never seen and took the lives of the staff!

Shouldn't we find their spaceship as soon as possible and launch an all-out attack, with the Ultra Garrison too?

Indeed…

As long as we can confirm the spaceship's location, we can immediately fire the special missile "Vulture" at it.

Please wait! We can't rule out that Dr. Namikawa is inside that spaceship!

Besides, are you certain the Vulture can destroy it?

If… our state-of-the-art Vulture doesn't work, what will you do then?
That couldn't possibly happen, could it?
Muramatsu, the Vulture will do the job…

No, that's exactly why…

First, we find out what they want, give it to them if we can, negotiate for them to hand over Dr. Namikawa, and then have them go home!
What on earth are you saying?
You're telling us to surrender to them?

No, wait…

Dr. Namikawa is an authority on space rocket development. He's essential to our TDF science group!

He was originally due to join our science group after finishing his work at the Science Center… We have to rescue him safely, whatever it takes!

All right then… Muramatsu, I'll leave it entirely to you! I'm counting on you!
Sir…
Director… are you sure about this? Going along with that idea…

Muramatsu says he'll take responsibility! Let's leave it to him…

This, uh… talking with aliens or whatever… Right, Muramatsu?

Achoo!

Hmm, I bet somebody somewhere is saying bad things about me.
Ain't you overthinkin' it?
Hm? You came from the international defense organization EAGLE… Surely you didn't come just to eat?
That's right… I came to tell ye somethin' important.
Something important?
If you mean Daita, he just left a moment ago… What's going on?
Something important?
Mr. Oiwa just left a moment ago… Is something wrong?
But… that's a treat for after my second helpin'! Master!! Seconds!

Why, you! I didn't add my special curry to the menu just so you could eat it!

Besides…!?

Hongo, Hayato…

…Oh, right, they're not here anymore, are they? Oops, oops… I'm still not used to it.
What's wrong? Has something terrible happened again?
To rescue Dr. Namikawa, the Science Patrol guys are going to try negotiating with the aliens!
That's it… That's what I came to tell ye too. It was the Science Patrol's Cap who came up with it.

The Science Patrol's Cap?

Even so… negotiating with aliens, he's taken on quite a job.

But… if lives are at stake, maybe I'd have done the same.
I wonder about that. After all, they're aliens who don't even speak our language! Actually rescuing the hostage…

No, no, you never know. After all, it's the Science Patrol's Cap who said it! Surely he's got something…?

Where'd that guy go?
What!? Without even paying… Does he think he's got a tab here? Honestly…

Ide and Hayata of the Science Patrol are going back into the Science Center.

It seems they'll try talking with the alien. But the Black Cross Army may show up too. You'll stand by at the scene as well.

uncertain: U04735: pun on Arashi's name (嵐 = storm) kept by glossing in quotes.
U04751/U04752/U04754/U04759: baseball puns adapted (batting a thousand, intentional walk, fastballs, pitching change, bottom of the ninth).
U04758: speaker セミ型の宇宙人 (Cicada-Like Alien, i.e. Baltan) laugh rendered 'Fwoh-fwoh…'.
U04782-U04785: missile ハゲタカ rendered 'Vulture'.
U04799/U04801: the hero is asked about Daita while Daita appears in the same scene; likely an alternate branch. Translated as written.
U04804: Taki forgets Hongo and Hayato left Japan (B0056).
